Keep the same character identities, faces, costumes, weapons, and environment throughout the entire video. Riven uses the exact same sword shown in the Riven reference. Ally Soldier uses the same appearance, costume, armor, and weapon shown in his character reference. The provided battle final-frame reference establishes the situation: Riven and Ally Soldier are trapped together at the center of a large circle of SOLDIERS on the mountain road. They are surrounded from every direction. Use the battle final-frame only to understand the current situation and spatial continuity. Do not recreate its exact wide composition. Do not recreate the exact positions of the SOLDIERS. The HOME/VILLAGE reference represents Riven's home far away across the mountain valley. === TECHNICAL === 16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy. Late sunset. Grounded realistic sword combat. Natural physical movement. Natural English dialogue and lip sync. Natural cinematic camera movement. Keep the action simple and visually readable. Avoid unnecessary rapid cuts. All SOLDIERS belong to the same army. Riven and Ally Soldier are their only targets. SOLDIERS never attack other SOLDIERS. Riven and Ally never attack each other. Riven is already exhausted from prolonged fighting. No graphic gore. No subtitles. No background music. === VIDEO SUMMARY === Riven and Ally are surrounded by a large army. They stay close together and fight defensively, trying to hold their position inside the encirclement. During the confrontation, a distant archer finds an opening and fires one arrow directly toward Riven. The arrow is already flying toward Riven when Ally notices it. Ally shouts her name. At the last moment, Ally throws his own body into the arrow's path. The arrow hits Ally instead of Riven. Riven catches him. Ally dies in her arms. While grieving, Riven notices enormous columns of dark smoke and distant fire rising from the direction of her home village. She realizes something terrible is happening there. Riven does not leave yet. She looks back down at Ally and slowly lowers him onto the ground. === SCENES === Shot 1 — HOLDING THE LINE Do not begin with another wide shot. Begin much closer to the confrontation. A SOLDIER very close to the camera moves quickly across the foreground. His body and armor briefly obscure most of the frame. As he clears the frame, reveal Riven and Ally in a closer medium combat shot. They are still trapped at the center of the same surrounding army. Riven and Ally stand close together, almost back-to-back. They are not advancing through the army. They are holding their position and fighting defensively. Riven protects one side. Ally protects the opposite side. Many SOLDIERS remain visible around them at different depths, clearly maintaining the encirclement. One SOLDIER moves toward Riven. Riven blocks the attack and forces him backward. Another SOLDIER approaches Ally from the opposite direction. Ally defends himself. Riven and Ally remain close together and protect each other's blind sides. Riven is visibly exhausted. Her breathing is heavy. Her movements are still skilled, but she is becoming slower. Keep this combat brief and simple. Shot 2 — THE ARROW During the confrontation, one SOLDIER with a military bow is positioned farther away behind the surrounding formation. He sees a clear opening toward Riven. Riven is occupied defending herself. Ally is also occupied nearby. Neither of them notices the archer. The archer raises his bow. He aims directly at Riven. He fires ONE arrow. Clearly show the arrow leaving the bow and flying rapidly toward Riven. Riven does not see it. The arrow is already in flight. Only now does Ally notice the flying arrow. This is the first moment Ally becomes aware of the danger. He sees the arrow heading directly toward Riven. Ally urgently shouts: "RIVEN!" Riven hears him and begins to turn. But the arrow is already too close. Ally reacts instantly. He throws his entire body toward Riven. He does not block the arrow with his weapon. He does not push Riven away. He physically throws himself into the path of the already-flying arrow. The arrow was going directly toward Riven. At the final moment, Ally's body crosses in front of her. The arrow strikes Ally instead. Riven remains unharmed. Ally immediately loses his strength. Riven catches him as he collapses. Shot 3 — ALLY'S LAST MOMENT Stay close to Riven and Ally. Keep the camera calm. Do not introduce unnecessary action or camera changes. Riven supports Ally and lowers with him toward the ground. The surrounding SOLDIERS become visually secondary. The emotional focus is now entirely on Riven and Ally. Riven holds Ally in her arms. She looks at him in shock. She understands that he deliberately took the arrow meant for her. Riven quietly asks: "Why?" Ally looks at her weakly. He answers: "You would've done the same." A brief silence. Ally loses his remaining strength. His body becomes still. Riven realizes he is gone. She continues holding him. She does not immediately move. Her expression is devastated. Shot 4 — THE DISTANT FIRE While Riven is still holding Ally, something far across the valley catches her attention. Riven slowly raises her head. She looks toward the distant horizon. Follow her gaze across the mountain valley. Far away, in the direction of Riven's home village, several enormous columns of thick dark smoke rise into the late-sunset sky. A distant orange fire glow burns beneath the smoke. Keep the village very far away. Do not move into the village. Do not show detailed destruction yet. Only establish that a major fire is burning in the direction of Riven's home. Return the emotional focus to Riven. She stares at the distant smoke. Her grief is joined by sudden fear. She understands that something terrible is happening at home. But Riven does NOT run away. She does NOT stand up and leave Ally. After looking at the distant fire, Riven slowly lowers her gaze. She looks back down at Ally in her arms. Her expression remains deeply grief-stricken. She stays with him for one final quiet moment. Then Riven slowly and carefully lowers Ally's body onto the ground. She supports his head and shoulders and lays him down gently. Riven remains kneeling beside Ally. She has not left him yet. End on this quiet emotional moment. CUT.、16:9
